view_frame: The drawing is a single silhouette view (Front) of an axisymmetric object. The vertical axis of the drawing corresponds to the world Z axis (height). The horizontal axis corresponds to the world X axis (radius). The object is centered on the Z axis (X=0).

features.placement: Revolve the closed profile 360 degrees about the Z axis. The profile is defined by an outer wall curve and an inner wall curve offset by the wall thickness. The base is at Z=0. The profile vertices (radius, height) are approximated from the silhouette: (0,0) -> (45,0) -> (45,10) -> (40,30) -> (15,60) -> (15,100) -> (30,110) -> (30,120) -> (27,120) -> (27,110) -> (12,100) -> (12,60) -> (37,30) -> (42,10) -> (42,0) -> (0,0).
features.evidence: Single silhouette outline showing a vase shape with a flared rim, narrow neck, and bulbous body. The user notes specify 'Greek vase from a single silhouette'.

edit_rules: Changing the wall_thickness parameter must update the inner profile vertices to maintain the specified offset from the outer profile.
Changing the height parameter must scale the Z coordinates of all profile vertices proportionally.
Changing the max_radius parameter must scale the X coordinates of the body vertices proportionally.
unresolved: The floor thickness is assumed to be equal to the wall thickness (3mm) as it is not explicitly dimensioned, though the wall thickness was provided via clarification.
